# Prefilled values

`settings` loads a shared config and sets two of its fields for this runbook. `Environment` is locked, so the runbook's value is the one readers get.

<Inputs
  id="settings"
  path="boilerplate.yml"
  prefilledVariables={{ Region: "eu-west-1", Environment: "production" }}
/>

<Command
  id="show"
  inputsId="settings"
  env={{ REGION: "{{ .inputs.Region }}", ENVIRONMENT: "{{ .inputs.Environment }}" }}
  outputs={["where"]}
  command={`echo "where=$ENVIRONMENT@$REGION" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"`}
/>
